snapshot.title: Surface TESS/asteroid data provenance on mission target cards
snapshot.description: Targets come from real TESS exoplanet candidates and asteroid catalogues but this is invisible. The science hook - the game's primary differentiator - is never shown to the player during target selection.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Target card shows the real catalogue source (e.g. TESS candidate, MPC asteroid)
A one-line science context blurb appears on the target card (e.g. detected by NASA TESS in 2022)
The science context is also shown briefly during space transit to reinforce the connection

- LaunchpadSelectorPanel: target card DetailsLabel shows source + blurb as second line
- OutboundPreviewTransition: _current_science_blurb read from detected targets; shown in science panel caption during TRAVEL phase
